objective: See the epic; the frozen pre-registration states the claim, the starts, the reading, the runs, the controls, the predictions and the stop.
status: Computed 2026-11-26, counted a second time by the thread, referee pending: on starts built by hand, with the first seed and the place of the link held fixed, what the first seed's own descent makes differs with the form of the second seed, through the link. 19 of 20 registered predictions hold, the four exact replications of the drafter's probe among them (270 of 270 studies). Held out: unlinked, nothing differs (90 of 90); linked, three or more classes in 87 of 90 studies, 59% to 87% of pairs told apart, 422 to 1,309 pairs a row told apart only after round 1 with every round-1 birth with a first-seed ancestor the same; the class never a function of the held knot alone, and a function of the held knot with the second seed's births by round in 49 of 90. One prediction fails: two or more fates in 37 studies of 90 (40 needed). The knot test was cut to half after it had started; none failed.
title: The place held fixed, the form changed: what the first seed's descent makes, on built starts
